data.title: Polymarket G2 Option Drops 18.5% in Counter-Strike Playoff Market
data.description: The win probability for the G2 option in a Polymarket submarket tied to the Counter-Strike matchup between G2 and Legacy fell sharply from 62% one hour ago to 43.5%, a drop of 18.5%. According to ChainCatcher, the move occurred in the market for map 1 round handicap: G2 (-3.5) versus Legacy (+3.5) in the FISSURE PLAYGROUND playoffs. The article said related breaking news may have affected the shift.

data.title: Cascade Stops Operations, Users Can Withdraw Remaining Funds
data.description: Cascade, formerly Perennial, has announced that it is stopping operations. Users can withdraw remaining funds from their Cascade accounts through an official designated link using Privy Home login. According to PANews, the platform said it had spent the past five years building a modern brokerage experience for global markets, centered on 24/7 access and unlimited availability.

data.title: Revolut Says Limited Customer Data Exposed in Email Scam
data.description:
Revolut Ltd. said a limited number of customers had sensitive information disclosed in a scam involving an unauthorized third party that used a legitimate government email domain, according to Bloomberg.

The company did not say how many customers were affected.

data.title: Israeli Troops Fire on Unarmed Palestinians in the West Bank, Video Shows
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, a witness video filmed on the 12th showed Israeli troops opening fire on a group of unarmed Palestinians in the West Bank, injuring one man after more than 14 shots were fired.

data.title: Crypto Brokerage Platform Cascade Shuts Down Operations
data.description:
Crypto brokerage platform Cascade, formerly Perennial, has announced that it is shutting down operations after five years of building a unified platform for global markets. According to ChainCatcher, the company said the decision was not made lightly and thanked supporters for their backing over the years.

Cascade said it has already stopped operating. Users can withdraw remaining funds from Cascade CLS+trading through the official designated link after logging in via Privy Home.

data.title: Solana Social Wallet Hey Wallet Says It Will Shut Down Its Product
data.description:
Solana social wallet Hey Wallet said on X that it will shut down its product. According to ChainCatcher, the wallet allowed users to send SOL through posts, tip creators, mint NFTs, and trade on X, Discord, and Telegram.

Hey Wallet thanked users who used these features and reminded them to back up their wallets.

data.title: Ukraine Prepares for New Round of Talks in October, Budanov Says
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Ukraine is preparing to hold a new round of talks in October in a trilateral format involving Ukraine, Russia, and the United States, according to Ukrainian Presidential Office Chief Budanov.

data.title: Philippine Ferry Fire Death Toll Rises To 76
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Philippine rescuers recovered 41 more charred remains from a ferry fire, lifting the death toll to 76 and leaving 13 people unaccounted for. Forensic teams were working to identify the victims after 30 bodies recovered on Friday were brought to a port in Coron town, where temporary tents were set up for processing. The ferry was carrying more than 130 people when it caught fire near the end of its more than 20-hour journey. Firefighters entered the vessel for the first time on Friday after extinguishing the blaze more than a day after it broke out, and the Coast Guard said burnt remains were found in the ferry's economy accommodation section. Philippine Coast Guard official Geronimo Tuvilla said the immediate priority was to identify the victims and determine the cause of the fire. The Maritime Industry Authority, citing survivor accounts, said two explosions were heard inside the vessel shortly before the fire broke out.

data.title: Four More Wallets Rank Among Top 12 Hyperliquid Priority Fee Payers
data.description: Four additional wallets are among the top 12 wallets paying Hyperliquid priority fees, according to HyperliquidNews monitoring. The main wallet paid 10,100 HYPE, according to Odaily, worth $806,000.

data.title: BRICS Leaders Reaffirm Multilateralism in New Delhi Declaration
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting New Delhi Declaration reaffirmed support for multilateralism, called on all parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement to continue fulfilling existing commitments and maintain and intensify efforts to address climate change, and opposed unilateral, punitive, discriminatory and protectionist measures that are inconsistent with international law, including carbon border adjustment mechanisms.

data.title: Saudi Civil Defense Says Houthi Attack in Jazan Injures Two
data.description: Saudi Civil Defense said an attack by Yemen's Houthi movement in Tuwwal County, Jazan Province, injured two people and damaged several buildings and some vehicles. According to Sina Finance, the agency said the attack on civilian targets was a blatant violation of international humanitarian law and that the matter had been handled under established procedures. The Houthi movement said Saudi warplanes carried out 129 airstrikes across seven Yemeni provinces in the past 48 hours and warned that the strikes would not go unanswered or unpunished.

data.title: Yemen's Houthi Forces Say They Struck Saudi Military Facilities With Missiles and Drones
data.description: Yemen's Houthi military spokesman Yahya said the group carried out an operation against Saudi military action in Yemen, hitting an arms depot inside a military base in Saudi Arabia's Shearalah area and a command-and-control center responsible for directing and coordinating military operations against Yemen and its people. According to Sina Finance, Yahya said the operation used a large number of ballistic missiles and drones, and that the targets were hit with precise direct strikes. He warned that if Saudi Arabia continues military operations against Yemen, Houthi forces will carry out larger and more intense attacks on deeper targets inside Saudi Arabia, and Saudi Arabia will bear serious consequences.

data.title: Iraq and Iran Foreign Ministers Discuss Border Crossing Closures and Saudi Attack
data.description: According to Jin10, on September 12 local time, Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein spoke by phone with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and discussed Iraq's recent temporary closure of some border crossings with Iran, the follow-up arrangements, the attack on Saudi Arabia, and progress in the related investigation.

data.title: CryptoQuant Says Bitcoin Must Clear $81,700 to Confirm New Bull Market
data.description:
CryptoQuant said bitcoin needs to break above $81,700 to confirm that a new bull market is underway. According to NS3.AI, the asset’s 24% rally over two weeks has stalled as it has traded between $76,000 and $82,000.

CryptoQuant said bitcoin may find support at $70,000 if it weakens further. The firm also identified a lower support zone between $62,000 and $65,000 if the price falls more sharply.

data.title: Thailand Proposes Stablecoin Transfer Rule With 5 Million Baht Daily Cap
data.description: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed a stablecoin transfer rule that would require customers to use wallets verified as their own. According to NS3.AI, the rule would prohibit deposits from another person's account and withdrawals to another person's account through supervised operators. Transfers would be capped at 5 million baht per day per person per operator.

data.title: Bitcoin Suisse Plans to Cut Up to 60 Jobs in Switzerland
data.description:
Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to 60 jobs in Switzerland, affecting about half of its Swiss workforce. According to NS3.AI, the company is also closing its IT development site in Copenhagen.

CEO Andrej Majcen said the restructuring is intended to support international growth and is not linked to difficult crypto market conditions.

data.title: ECB’s Lagarde Says Inflation Shock Will Persist Longer
data.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said euro-area inflation will stay elevated for some time, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Polymarket Sabalenka-Rybakina First-Set Games Over Odds Swing Sharply
data.description: Catcher Predict reported a sharp move in the Polymarket submarket for the US Open WTA match between Aryna Sabalenka and Elena Rybakina. According to ChainCatcher, the probability of the "Over" option in the first-set total games market O/U 8.5 fell from 78.5% one hour earlier to 50%, a 28.5 percentage-point drop.

data.title: Tesla Sets Oct. 1 Event for Next-Generation Roadster
data.description: Tesla Inc. teased an Oct. 1 event to showcase its next-generation Roadster, according to Bloomberg. CEO Elon Musk first unveiled the niche vehicle in November 2017.

data.title: U.S. No Longer the Default Choice for Weapons Purchases and Fund Storage, Axios Reports
data.description: According to Jin10, Axios reported that the United States is gradually no longer the default choice for other governments to buy weapons and store funds, and it has also lost appeal for foreign students.
